name: @gobing-ai/spur
description: Spur — a local-first harness engineering toolkit that wraps mainstream coding agents with constraint checking, workflow orchestration, and history analytics.
author: Robin Min <minlongbing@gmail.com>

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && find apps packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && mkdir -p dist
scripts.build:scripts: bun run build:plugin-lib && superskill script convert sp batch-preflight.ts && superskill script convert sp feature-sync-bounded.ts && superskill script convert sp history-anatomy-cache.ts && superskill script convert sp pr-reviewing.ts && superskill script convert sp daily-summary/daily-summary.ts && superskill script convert sp dogfood-testing/detect-pipeline-driving.ts && superskill script convert sp dogfood-testing/validate-report.ts
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:scripts && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur' build && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur-server' build && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur-web' build
scripts.autofix: bun run format && bun run typecheck
scripts.refresh-plugin: claude plugin uninstall sp@spur -y && rm -rf ~/.claude/plugins/cache/spur && claude plugin marketplace update spur && claude plugin install sp@spur && superskill install sp --marketplace .claude-plugin
scripts.tasks: sh -c 'if [ -z "$1" ]; then echo "Usage: bun run tasks <wbs>" >&2; exit 1; fi; bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts workflow run .spur/workflows/task-pipeline.yaml --vars "{\"wbs\":\"$1\",\"profile\":\"auto\"}"' --
scripts.features: sh -c 'if [ -z "$1" ]; then echo "Usage: bun run features <featureId>" >&2; exit 1; fi; bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts workflow run .spur/workflows/feature-dev.yaml --vars "{\"featureId\":\"$1\",\"profile\":\"auto\"}"' --
scripts.test-pre-check: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-pre-check --fail-on warning
scripts.test-post-check: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-post-check --fail-on warning
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test:coverage
scripts.spur-check: bun run link-check && bun run transition-shim-check && bun run script-contract-check && bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check && bun run test && bun run test-post-check
scripts.spur-check-new: bun run link-check && bun run transition-shim-check && bun run script-contract-check && bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check && bun run test && bun run test-post-check && bun run corpus-check
scripts.test-pre-check:full: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-pre-check --fail-on warning --verbose
scripts.test-post-check:full: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-post-check --fail-on warning --verbose
scripts.check:full: bun run lint && bun run test:coverage
scripts.spur-check:full: bun run link-check && bun run transition-shim-check && bun run script-contract-check && bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check:full && bun run test:coverage && bun run test-post-check:full
scripts.spur-check-new:full: bun run link-check && bun run transition-shim-check && bun run script-contract-check && bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check:full && bun run test:coverage && bun run test-post-check:full && bun run corpus-check
scripts.load-history: DATABASE_URL='.spur/spur.db' bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts history import && DATABASE_URL='.spur/spur.db' bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts history analyze
